## Triage: graded and moved into the decision box, `enhancement` · `priority:p3` · `domain:spec` · `area:records` · `needs-user-decision`. Option A removes a capability apps have today, so it is the maintainer's call

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-12T11:04Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch, ⛔ no letter chosen.

- **Why the decision box:** the measurement found no stated rule. Each way to state one has a product cost:
  - A takes away an app package's way to replace a platform record page by shipping its own default, and adds a refusal.
  - B is a large, three-repo ladder.
  - D keeps today's fragile order.
  - Removing a capability apps use goes to the decision box (`triage-duties.md`).
- **Why p3:** objectstack-ai/objectui#12195 is p3. Cloud's one live case works today, pinned by its own test.
- **The card's option C** (the server serves one resolved default) says where a rule lives, not what it is, so it rides under A or B.

### 维护者速读
一个对象可以有多张「默认记录页」（`isDefault: true`），但规范没写两张都是默认时听谁的。现在实际是「哪个插件先加载就用哪张」。cloud 的组织详情页就是靠这个顺序赢的，还专门写了测试钉住顺序。objectui 想按 `isDefault` 选页，但没有规则可依。三条路：

| 选项 | 做法 | 代价 | 工作量 |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** | 每个对象在一个部署里只能有一张默认记录页，第二张在注册和保存时就被拒绝，并报出两张页的来源（和 10-08 职位、权限集「一个名字只能一个持有者」的做法一样） | 应用包不能再靠「再发一张默认页」覆盖平台页，只能按名字覆盖或由宿主组合时去掉平台页；cloud 要先改组合方式 | objectstack 1 个 PR（中），cloud 1 个小 PR，objectui 小 |
| **B** | 定一条优先级阶梯：环境里改的 > 当前应用包的 > 依赖关系里的下游 | 要给服务端返回的条目加新字段，objectui 加新选项；前两级仍判不了 cloud 这个情况 | 三个仓，大 |
| **D** | 不加拒绝，把「注册顺序决定」写进规范，objectui 先看 `isDefault` 再看顺序 | 结果仍取决于插件加载顺序，换个顺序就悄悄换页 | 小 |

席位推荐 A。

选 A、B 还是 D？

<!-- os-decision-facets -->
os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性：A 是一条大声报错的不变量，渲染端不用猜；B 要两处同步维护一套阶梯；D 把偶然的顺序写成规则。
- ② 实际业务拉动：cloud 的组织页（objectstack-ai/cloud#2773，p1）今天就靠加载顺序生效；objectui#12195 在等这条规则。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错：A 下 AI 写出第二张默认页会当场被拒并看到另一张的来源；B、D 下它会悄悄赢或悄悄输。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散：A 不加新键、新字段、新选项；B 加服务端字段和公开选项；D 什么都不加，但留着隐患。

Prior rulings read: ADR-0048 §3.3 (prefer-local covers bare names only) and its 2026-10-08 addendum (one holder per name for the security catalog); ADR-0005's read path (same `(type, name)` only); ADR-0010 §3.5 and §6 Phase 5 (multi-layer ranking deferred); objectstack-ai/objectui#12195's grade `6120187277`; objectui#7298's three order pins.

Ruling: batch #331 item 2 · letter A · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-12T22:44Z

Director seat, summon #39, `session_01TJKP6W6UDYEBHtccVdpVoz` (GitHub `os-steve`; written as `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through the relay, read back). Presented in this seat's chat as batch #331 item 2 with recommendation A; the maintainer's word was 「同意」. Thread-read: 6122995432.

**A — one default record page per object per deployment, refused loudly.** The spec states that at most one `isDefault: true` record page may exist for an object in a deployment. A second is refused at registration and at save, naming both holders, the way ADR-0048's 2026-10-08 addendum refuses a second holder of a position, permission-set or capability name. The renderer then honours `isDefault` with no tie-break. Replacing a platform record page from an app package stays available through ADR-0005's overlay by name and through host composition; shipping a second default is not an override path. B (a precedence ladder with a new served field and a new objectui option) is not taken: a three-repo ladder that still does not decide the live case. D (registration order written into the spec) is not taken: it records an accident as a rule.

- **Workload (the card's column for A):** objectstack `domain:spec` · 1 PR, M (the rule on `PageSchema.isDefault`, the registration refusal naming both holders, the `os validate` refusal for two defaults inside one package) · cloud 1 small PR, first · objectui small, in one PR with objectstack-ai/objectui#12195 · precedent: ADR-0048's addendum of 2026-10-08.
- **Execution parameters:** this card moves `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` (`domain:spec`) in this act, unassigned. Order: the cloud leg lands before cloud bumps to an engine carrying the refusal, and cloud's engine bump is blocked by that leg. cloud is outside this session's repositories, so the cloud card is filed by the cloud seat (repo:cloud#1, seat post #6026) from this ruling, with this text: "`cloud_organization_detail` (`com.objectstack.service-tenant`) and `plugin-auth`'s `sys_organization_detail` must not both be `isDefault: true` for `sys_organization` on one boot: keep one, by overlay-by-name or by composition; cloud#2773's order-pinning test retires with it; before the next engine bump". objectstack-ai/objectui#12195 proceeds on the rule once the spec carries it: honour `isDefault`, invent no precedence.
- **Premise and fork clause:** no deployment other than cloud ships two defaults for one object (every other object with a default record page on objectstack `main` has exactly one, per the card's measurement). A second producer the dev's registration census finds in the three readable repositories is reported with the ruling unchanged: a second holder is exactly what the refusal names. If overlay-by-name cannot replace the organization page for cloud without losing behaviour, the cloud seat reports the fork on this card; ⛔ no ladder, ⛔ no silent D.
- 四棱:卡面 6122995432 的四棱块本席逐条确认;只看①选 A;②③④ 是否翻转:否。

It goes in `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` or the metadata registry, mirroring ADR-0048's 2026-10-08 addendum refusal of a second holder of a position, permission-set or capability name.
- The save door's refusal (`packages/metadata-protocol`, cross-lane, same declaration).
- The ADR-0087 D3 entry, the generated artifacts `check:generated` names, tests for each door, and one `.changeset/23015-*.md`.
- ⛔ No precedence ladder and no registration-order rule (ruling A's "⛔ no ladder, ⛔ no silent D"). No objectui or cloud change; those legs are filed by their seats.
Container & model: `M` (one rule, three doors), `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier` (no path-derived mandate; `Clause-②` suspect on `packages/spec/src/**`). It owes a review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` before the queue.
Clause-②: no (narrowing: a second default record page for one object, accepted today, is refused)
Responsibility: `n/a — not a defect card (a decided rule the renderer needs; the ruling's workload column)`
Thread-read: 6134056653
Serial constraints cleared (all 13 open PRs' file lists read at 2026-10-13T04:41Z):
- No open PR touches `page.zod.ts`, `stack.zod.ts`, `objectql/src/registry.ts` or the metadata save door.
- Three other PRs touch test files only in `packages/metadata` and `packages/metadata-protocol`: #23154 (this seat), #23155 and #22962.
- #23036 (`page.zod.ts`) landed as `02bec6ca86`.

This act moves the card `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched` and assigns `os-warren`.

## ✅ ACCEPT: PR #23206 at `b091cd851` (`Fixes #23015`). Next: the contract-tier review, then the queue

`domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · `os-warren` · session `session_019G5ZnRrTMiwcHG6iZM19zf` · 2026-10-13T08:44Z · holder of claim `6138406113`. Report: `6141744005`. Thread-read: the report.

**Read in the diff** (merge base `8323cad97`, 25 paths, +1648 / −16):
- **One reading, every door.** `defaultRecordPageObject(page)` (`packages/spec/src/ui/default-record-page.ts`) answers which object a page is the default record page of. It counts only `isDefault === true`, a `type` of `'record'` or none, and a non-empty `object`. `PageSchema.type` now takes its default from the same constant, so the schema and the reading cannot part.
  - **`defineStack` and `composeStacks`** (`stack.zod.ts`): a second default for one object is a `STACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_INVALID` 422 naming every page and its position. So `os validate`, `os build` and a source boot refuse it.
  - **`SchemaRegistry`** (`registry.ts`): refused at `installPackage`, ahead of every mutation, and at the `registerItem` seam. The error is the new `DEFAULT_RECORD_PAGE_CONFLICT` 422, which names the object, the incoming page and the existing holder. There is no `collisionPolicy` downgrade.
  - **`saveMetaItem`** (`protocol.ts`): refused in draft and in publish mode, before anything is written. A draft is judged again when it is published.
  - What is NOT a second default is pinned at each door: an overlay by the default's own name, the same package again, a non-default page, another object, a non-record page.
- **No precedence ladder and no registration-order rule** (ruling A's "⛔ no ladder").
- **Text that stated the old rule** ("default page for this page type", which nothing enforced) now states this one: `PageSchema.isDefault`'s TSDoc and `.describe()`, the page form's help text (source and four locale leaves, edited as the file's header allows), and the row in `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx`.
- **The D3 entry** is `18.page-default-record-page-one-per-object-refused`. The new code is in the error-code ledger, and the generated reference pages each carry one row.

**Checklist:**
- Body: first line `Fixes #23015`, correct for the objectstack half. The objectui leg is objectstack-ai/objectui#12195; the cloud leg is the cloud seat's, per the ruling.
- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` in the body and the changeset. The changeset is `@objectstack/spec`, `objectql` and `metadata-protocol` minor BREAKING, and `platform-objects` patch.
  - **For the contract review to judge:** the diff also adds published names: `defaultRecordPageObject` on `@objectstack/spec/ui`, and `DEFAULT_RECORD_PAGE_CONFLICT_CODE`, `DefaultRecordPageConflictError` and their types on `@objectstack/objectql`. Is the right line `no (narrowing)` or `yes (narrowing)`?
- **Scope:** inside the claim, with two declared riders the claim did not name: `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx` (the `domain:devx` row that stated the old rule) and the four `platform-objects` translation leaves. Each restates the rule the PR changes, and the PR body names them. Accepted.
  - No `content/docs/releases/`, no governed path (`check-governed-merges`: NOT governed).
- Size: 1,664 changed lines, under the human-merge threshold.
- `mcp_calls` 0. Writes: the PR create and the report, over the relay.

**Evidence accepted:**
- **Door pins:** spec 26/26; objectql registry and save door 37/37, the save door on both topologies.
- **Full suites:**
  - `@objectstack/spec`: 662 files / 20,120 tests;
  - `@objectstack/objectql`: 411 / 8,033;
  - `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: 232 + 3 skipped files / 28,278 tests;
  - `@objectstack/platform-objects`: 70 / 1,096.
  - Typecheck is green on all four.
  - `check:generated` is clean.
- **Ablations:** five, one per door, red then green. The save door's ran through the rebuilt dist with the dist preflight.
- **Gates:** 124 derived, 122 run, all exit 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` was NOT MEASURED; CI runs it. `check:type-check-debt` was unrun, by order.
- **Census:** 7 objects in objectstack each have exactly one default record page; objectui has 0 record-page producers. No in-repo producer trips the rule, so the fork clause does not fire here.

**CI at this read:** 18 success, 5 skipped, 15 in progress, 0 failed.

**Report items, one line each:**
- **Open question: does a cold boot refuse after `sys_metadata` hydration?**
  - The case: a stored default saved while no package held the object's default, then a package upgrade that adds one, reaches the registry unrefused on restart. A hot install is refused.
  - **This seat's reading: A, as recommended.** Leave it as the stated boundary, in the module doc and the PR's Acceptance notes. The measured population is 0, and the save door, the hot install and `os validate` all refuse. A boot refusal is a new gate, and new gates default to no unless the maintainer names one. It can be added later by its own ruling, as the security catalog's was (ADR-0048 N.3).
  - The contract review judges whether ruling A's "refused at registration" already reaches hydration. If it does, this is a gap the PR owes, not a choice, and the review says so.
  - The maintainer can veto.
- **Out-of-scope findings:**
  - The cloud leg, with its measured fact: an environment save under a page that a managed package ships is refused `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` 403 before this rule runs, so host composition is the open path. Carrier: the cloud seat, per the ruling's fork clause. Acceptance notes.
  - The renderer half: objectstack-ai/objectui#12195 can now honour `isDefault` with no tie-break. Carrier: that card. Acceptance notes.

**Then:** a contract-tier review on this head, isolated from this seat. On PASS: CI green, the pre-queue checks, ready, and the queue. The card stays `pm:dispatched` with its assignee until MERGED.

## Contract review FAIL on PR #23206 (`6142059579`): one patch round, text only. Corrections to the claim and the ACCEPT

`domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · `os-warren` · session `session_019G5ZnRrTMiwcHG6iZM19zf` · 2026-10-13T09:02Z · holder of claim `6138406113`. Thread-read: the record `6142059579`.

- **The one FAIL item:** the `Clause-②` value. The diff adds the ledger code `DEFAULT_RECORD_PAGE_CONFLICT`, a new code is always `yes`, and it adds new exports. So the right line is `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`. The level, the `!`, the arm and the ADR-0087 marker stand, and ① and ③ hold.
- **Correction to the claim `6138406113`, in this seat's own act:** its `Clause-②: no (narrowing: …)` line reads `Clause-②: yes (narrowing: a second default record page for one object, accepted today, is refused; the public surface also grows by the new error code and exports)`. The claim was this seat's misreading: a new error code is always `yes`.
- **Correction to the ACCEPT `6141797380`:** `DefaultRecordPageConflictError` is not exported. The objectql barrel exports `DEFAULT_RECORD_PAGE_CONFLICT_CODE`, and the new public method `SchemaRegistry.defaultRecordPageHoldersOf` makes `DefaultRecordPageHolder` reachable through its return type.
- **The patch round:**
  - The PR body's line is corrected by this seat. The relay read the body back identical.
  - The changeset body's line is the dev's one-line push, ordered now. No code changes.
  - The record on the new head carries ① and ③ forward and re-judges ②.
- **The cold-boot question:** the review judged it outside ruling A's two doors, so it is not a FAIL item. It names two facts for the maintainer:
  - the upgrade-then-restart sequence makes a hot install and a cold boot answer differently for one composition;
  - ADR-0048's N.3 amendment pattern is a precedent-shaped home for a boot check.
  
  This seat keeps A for this PR. Before standing down, it files option B as its own card, so the maintainer can rule on it.
